Package domain

Class Stats

java.lang.Object
domain.Stats
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Stats extends Object implements Serializable
Stats of a player, from 1 to 10. They belong to the player, not to the character, so they apply to any character the player chooses. Each point above 1 adds 10 % to the base value.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

  • Method Details

    • get

      public int get(String stat) throws DOPOSoccerException
      Returns the level of a stat.
      Parameters:
      stat - "SPEED", "JUMP", "KICK" or "SURVIVAL"
      Returns:
      the level, from 1 to 10
      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - UNKNOWN_STAT if the name is not valid

    • getKickMultiplier

      public double getKickMultiplier()
      Returns the kick multiplier: 1 + 0.10 * (Kick - 1). Kick 5 gives 1.4. It multiplies the damage of kicks and power shots, not the speed of the ball.
      Returns:
      the kick multiplier

    • getMaxLife

      public int getMaxLife()
      Returns the maximum life: 100 * (1 + 0.10 * (Survival - 1)). Survival 3 gives 120.
      Returns:
      the maximum life

    • getSpeedMultiplier

      public double getSpeedMultiplier()

      public int getUpgradeCost(String stat) throws DOPOSoccerException
      Returns the price of the next point of a stat: 500, 1000, 2000... (500 * 2^(level - 1)).
      Parameters:
      stat - "SPEED", "JUMP", "KICK" or "SURVIVAL"
      Returns:
      price in points of the next point

    • upgrade

      public void upgrade(String stat) throws DOPOSoccerException
      Raises a stat one point. It does not charge anything: the store does.
      Parameters:
      stat - "SPEED", "JUMP", "KICK" or "SURVIVAL"
      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - UNKNOWN_STAT if the name is not valid, STAT_AT_MAX if it is already at 10
